g.text: routes here only when algorithmFamily == AlgMLKEM ("ml-kem");
before the JWE path used by aes-gcm / aes-cbc / rsa-oaep
60 bytes total, well under the KMS v2 1 kB Ciphertext limit
nonce (12 B) || AES-GCM(DEK seed) || tag (16 B)
The KEM ciphertext c (768/1088/1568 B, too big for
into the AES-GCM AAD by mlkemAAD(c) so a swapped
annotation fails the tag check on Decrypt.
(ct []byte, ss SharedSecret, err error) Encapsulate(tmpl AttributeSet)
(ss SharedSecret, err error) Decapsulate(ct []byte, tmpl AttributeSet)
KMAC-based KDF (NIST SP 800-185) that turns the ~32-byte
ML-KEM shared secret into the AES-256 key used to seal the
DEK seed. Both the shared secret and the derived key are
zeroed (defer clear(...)) immediately after use in p11.go.
aes.NewCipher(derivedKey) + cipher.NewGCM -> aead.Seal(nonce, DEK seed, mlkemAAD(kemCt))
decryptMLKEMWithContext: kemCt from Annotations ; ctx.FindMLKEMKeyPair(KeyId) ; kp.Decapsulate(kemCt) -> sharedSecret ;
same KDF/AES-GCM derivation ; aead.Open(nonce, sealed, mlkemAAD(kemCt)) -> DEK seed
